card.summary: H.R. 10357, the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act, amends the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to reform the tax treatment of digital assets. It establishes tax rules for digital asset transactions, creates exceptions for small fees, sets simplified accounting methods for widely traded digital assets, aligns rules for digital assets with comparable traditional financial assets, applies existing tax anti-abuse rules, clarifies mining and staking taxation, adjusts broker reporting requirements, and establishes a Digital Asset Voluntary Disclosure Program.
